texts.preamble: Workmen vs Mcd on 18 March, 2025 More Than 12 Years Old Case In The Court Of Sh. Mohinder Virat: Presiding Officer Industrial Tribunal-I, Rouse Avenue District Courts , New Delhi. Ref: F.24(22)/ND/214/2011/Lab./200 Dated: 11.02.2023 New Poit No.: 540/2016 Workmen
texts.facts: It is further claimed that the work load, responsibilities, duties and technical skill of ANMS are almost similar as those of the Staff Nurses and also their responsibilities are similar to the Staff Nurses. It is further claimed that despite all above, they have been placed in a lower pay band/pay grade. It is further submitted that upto 2nd Pay Commission, the difference in the salary of Staff Nurses and ANMs was almost negligible however, thereafter, there is a big difference in the Pay Band/Pay Grade payable to the Staff Nurses and to the ANMs. As such the ANMs are basically entitled to Pay Band-II and as far as question of Pay Grade is concerned, at least they should be granted the Pay POIT No. 540/2016 page 2 of 15 Grade one step lesser than the Staff Nurse i.e. Rs. 4200/-. It is further claimed that the action/inaction on the part of the management regarding non-fixation of salary in pay band-II and pay grade of Rs. 4200/- to the ANMs working in Health Centres/Hospitals is totally illegal, bad, unjust and malafide for the following, amongst other, reasons because the ANMs and Staff Nurses falls in the category of Nursing & Paramedical Staff. Further the duties of ANMs and the Staff Nurses are almost similar and on equal footing. In fact, the duties of Staff Nurses and ANMs. are as under :- DUTIES OF STAFF DUTIES OF ANMS NURSES: 1 Admission and discharge of ANM has to establish contacts with patients antenatal mothers, infants & toddlers & F.F. cases and advise them to attend the centre on clinic days. Food to To provide all the possible Patients, distribution of facilities to the patient whenever diets, etc. To contact LHV/Doctor in case the delivery is found abnormal and to accompany the patient on the advise of Doctor/LHV. 4 Administration of injection In clinics and on domiciliary visits, and administration of provide maternity and child health Injections, assistance in services, prenatal, postnatal, infect and pre-school care. 5 Dressing irrigation, 02 To assist the physician in IUCD Therapy, etc. clinics particularly in group education of patient and give follow up services as required. 6 Preparation of surgical To secure indigenous midwives supplies, bandage, etc. information on births and deaths and supply this to the computer for vital statistic and F.P. records. She has to work for the child care and is responsible for immunization for children. 3. Thus, from the above it is clear that the work and responsibilities of ANMs as well as Staff Nurses are almost on equal and same footing and hence the ANMS are also entitled to their salary in the Workmen vs Mcd on 18 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177019846/ 2 Pay Band-II and Pay Grade of Rs. 4200/- which is one step lesser than the Staff Nurse. It is further claimed that the the ANMs belong to the category of Nursing Staff and their non-inclusion in the pay band-ll in POIT No. 540/2016 page 4 of 15 parity with the Staff Nurses is totally illegal and malafide.
texts.arguments: It is prayed that an Award be made in favour of the workmen/ANMs holding therein that all the ANMs are entitled to grant of Pay Band-II and Pay Grade of Rs. 4200/- w.e.f. 01.01.2006 onwards with all consequential benefits either monetary or otherwise. 4. Written statement to the claim of the workmen was filed by the management (i.e. EDMC, NDMC and SDMC) wherein it is contended by the managements that the claim of the workmen is not an industrial dispute; that the Hospital Employees' Union has no locus standi to raise the present dispute and the present dispute has not been properly espoused by the Union and is liable to be dismissed. It is further contended that no demand notice has been served upon the management, as such the present dispute is not an industrial dispute and thus the reference is bad in law and is liable to be rejected. It is further contended that the demand of the ANMs is neither justified nor legal as the work or responsibilities of ANMs & ANMs are not entitled for salary in Pay Band - II and Pay Grade of Rs. 4200/- as demanded. It is further contended that the inclusion of the ANMs in the pay band-II in parity with the Staff Nurses is illegal/malafide. It is further contended that the post of ANMs and Staff Nurses falls in the category of Nursing & Paramedical Staff and the duties of ANMs and Staff Nurses are neither similar nor in POIT No. 540/2016 page 5 of 15 equal footing. It is further contended that the post of ANM is feeder cadre post of LHV and where as the 'A' Grade Staff Nurses is the initial cadre post of Nursing sister. It is further conteded that there is vast difference in the basic qualification, type of training and number of years of training of Staff Nurse and ANM and they cannot be equated. The technical tasks mentioned in duties of Staff Nurse are performed by S/N and not by ANM. Staff Nurse can perform duties in all wards of Hospital specialty operation theater, ICU, wherein ANM is for field based work and as such the present reference is liable to be answered in negative. 7. No rejoinder to the written statement of the management has been filed by the workman. 10. Per-contra, it has been argued by the ld. AR for the management that the present dispute is not an industrial dispute; the hospital employees union has no locus to raise the present dispute and the same has not been properly espoused; that the ANMs do not fulfill the recruitment rules applicable to staff nurses and both posts are entirely different having completely different promotional channels.
